title: The display behind the shelf
summary: What holds goods in Supermarket Simulator is a display with machinery of its own: a manager for displays, a colour side with its own data and manager, display data and subtypes, and a definition each display is built from.
body: A display is a system rather than a shelf model. The game runs displays through a manager of their own, which is why a new fixture can be added without every screen knowing about it in advance.
Colour is kept apart. Displays have colour data of their own and a manager for colour, so the same display can be offered in a different colouring without being rebuilt.
A display carries data. There is display data of its own, which is where what a display is and what it can hold is decided rather than being written into the model.
Displays come in kinds. There are subtypes of a display, so the game can tell one arrangement from another while treating both as the same sort of fixture.
Each one is built from a definition. There is a definition of a display of its own, so a fixture on the shelf of the shop's catalogue is an entry in data rather than a hand-placed object.
The image beside this entry is the game's own: the surface a display is built from, grey shelf panels with a dark sign printed for one of the lines it holds.
What this entry does not tell you: how many displays exist, how much each holds, or what any one costs. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Displays are run by a manager of their own.
The colour side has data of its own and a manager of its own.
A display carries data of its own.
A display has a definition of its own.
The game ships its own colour texture for a display, the surface a shelf is built around.
Shelf displays come in shapes of their own, a concave, a convex, a half and a half-quad, and each shape is named in the same colour palette the signs use.
facts.evidence: asset names: Concave_Shelf_1Default, Convex_Shelf_1Default, Half_Shelf_1Default, Half_Quad_Shelf_1Default, Concave_Shelf_London Hue, Convex_Shelf_Terracotta
